column3: 65L Internal Frame -- Can be rented at Philmont
Lightweight w/ space for water & rain gear
If bringing zip off pants, only bring 1 pair of legs
Goretex or generic equivalent. No Frog Togs
Closed toe. Crocs, Keen sandals or old sneakers work
Shorts & t shirt for sleeping only -- no cotton
Small -- only need a few ounces
KT tape strips or duct tape.
One needs to be clean -- ie never used for anything but water.
Depends on pack and what will be carried externally
